# ChiroSecure

> > ChiroSecure provides malpractice and business insurance for chiropractors, alongside educational resources, clinical research, and practice management guidance.

ChiroSecure serves the chiropractic profession with specialized insurance products while maintaining an extensive library of case studies, research summaries, and expert commentary on clinical techniques, compliance, and business operations. The platform features contributions from leading voices including Dr. Cathy Stack, Chen Yen, and organizations like Empowering Women in Chiropractic and the Foundation for Chiropractic Progress (F4CP).

## Key Topics

- Chiropractic malpractice insurance
- Vertebral subluxation
- Spinal manipulation techniques
- Pediatric chiropractic care
- Practice management and compliance
- Medicare and network billing
- Torque Release Technique (TRT)
- Cervical spine adjustments
- Clinical case studies
- ADHD management
- Journal of Chiropractic Medicine
- F4CP (Foundation for Chiropractic Progress)
- Dr. Cathy Stack
- Empowering Women in Chiropractic
- Medical necessity documentation

## Insurance and Risk Management

- [Tailoring Chiropractor Business Insurance to Your Practice](https://www.chirosecure.com/tailoring-chiropractor-business-insurance-to-your-practice): ChiroSecure business insurance customization and coverage options guide
- [The In/Out of Network Dilemma – Associated Risk Areas](https://www.chirosecure.com/the-in-out-of-network-dilemma-associated-risk-areas): Michael Miscoe on network participation and Medicare billing compliance
- [Are You Medically Necessary?](https://www.chirosecure.com/are-you-medically-necessary): Sam Collins on pre-authorization and medical necessity requirements

## Clinical Research and Case Studies

- [Improvement in Physical Resilience and Management of ADHD in a 12-year-old Male under Chiropractic Care](https://www.chirosecure.com/improvement-in-physical-resilience-and-management-of-adhd-in-a-12-year-old-male-under-chiropractic-care): Case report: ADHD management in pediatric patient using Torque Release
- [Sympathetic and parasympathetic responses to specific diversified adjustments to chiropractic vertebral subluxations of the cervical and thoracic spine](https://www.chirosecure.com/sympathetic-and-parasympathetic-responses-to-specific-diversified-adjustments-to-chiropractic-vertebral-subluxations-of-the-cervical-and-thoracic-spine): Research on autonomic responses to cervical/thoracic adjustments
- [Visit Frequency and Outcomes for Patients Using Ongoing Chiropractic Care for Chronic Low-Back and Neck Pain](https://www.chirosecure.com/visit-frequency-and-outcomes-for-patients-using-ongoing-chiropractic-care-for-chronic-low-back-and-neck-pain): Longitudinal study on visit frequency for chronic pain management
- [Don't Miss a Cervical Compression Fracture](https://www.chirosecure.com/dont-miss-a-cervical-compression-fracture): Dr. Cathy on diagnosing cervical compression fractures via x-ray
- [The Chiropractic Adjustment Mechanism Explained](https://www.chirosecure.com/the-chiropractic-adjustment-mechanism-explained): Dr. Mark Studin explains adjustment mechanisms and subluxation concepts
- [Chiropractic and rehabilitation management of a patient with extraforaminal entrapment of L4 nerve with balance problem](https://www.chirosecure.com/chiropractic-and-rehabilitation-management-of-a-patient-with-extraforaminal-entrapment-of-l4-nerve-with-balance-problem): Case study: L4 nerve entrapment with balance deficit rehabilitation

## Pediatric and Specialized Care

- [Cessation of cyclic vomiting in a 7-year-old girl after upper cervical chiropractic care](https://www.chirosecure.com/10165-2): Pediatric case: cyclic vomiting syndrome treated with upper cervical care
- [Disruptive Pediatrics meets Anatomy Trains](https://www.chirosecure.com/disruptive-pediatrics-meets-anatomy-trains): Dr. Drew and Tom Myers discuss fascial planes in pediatric chiropractic
- [Chiropractic treatment of hand and wrist pain in older people](https://www.chirosecure.com/chiropractic-treatment-of-hand-and-wrist-pain-in-older-people): Clinical research on geriatric hand/wrist pain treatment protocols
- [Temporomandibular Disorder Treated With Chiropractic Therapy](https://www.chirosecure.com/temporomandibular-disorder-treated-with-chiropractic-therapy): Case study on TMD treatment using spinal adjustments and soft tissue
- [Chiropractic management of Bell palsy with low-level laser and manipulation](https://www.chirosecure.com/chiropractic-management-of-bell-palsy-with-low-level-laser-and-manipulation): Case report: Bell palsy treated with GaAs laser and manipulation

## Practice Management and Business Operations

- [Hiring the Right Associate in this Market](https://www.chirosecure.com/hiring-the-right-associate-in-this-market): Chen Yen on hiring associates and scaling chiropractic practices
- [Are Investors the Big Practice Buyers in Chiropractic?](https://www.chirosecure.com/are-investors-the-big-practice-buyers-in-chiropractic): Analysis of investor trends in chiropractic practice acquisitions
- [You Will Now Be Connected](https://www.chirosecure.com/you-will-now-be-connected): Dr. Cathy on building connections in chiropractic practice
